entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I just got a message from Shiho.[n]It sounds like Kayo suddenly[n]came to her with an apology.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And—get this—she said "I'll take[n]care of the volleyball team.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I couldn't have done it without all[n]of you. Thanks for helping me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'm glad to see Lady Ann's feeling better!
